name: General Dynamics Ajax
protection: Modular armour. Programme troubled (IOC withdrawn Jan 2026). Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetrating the hull needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon.
visual_notes: Large, tall ASCOD-derived hull, 7 road wheels per side
Big two-man turret with stubby 40 mm cannon
Ares variant has a raised rear crew compartment and RWS
